metas.description:
★ 9.0 · 2008 · one of your favourites
Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live. He becomes filled with a sense of fearlessness and an unrelenting desire to…

metas.name: Game of Thrones
metas.description:
★ 8.5 · 2011 · one of your favourites
Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected…

metas.name: Friends
metas.description:
★ 8.4 · 1994 · one of your favourites
Six young people from New York City, on their own and struggling to survive in the real world, find the companionship, comfort and support they get from each other to be the perfect antidote to the pressures of life.

metas.name: The Office
metas.description:
★ 8.6 · 2005 · one of your favourites
The everyday lives of office employees in the Scranton, Pennsylvania branch of the fictional Dunder Mifflin Paper Company.

metas.name: Dark
metas.description:
★ 8.4 · 2017 · one of your favourites
A missing child sets four families on a frantic hunt for answers as they unearth a mind-bending mystery that spans three generations.

metas.name: Peaky Blinders
metas.description:
★ 8.5 · 2013 · one of your favourites
A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England and centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby, who means to move up in the world.

metas.name: Money Heist
metas.description:
★ 8.2 · 2017 · one of your favourites
To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion -…

metas.name: Sherlock
metas.description:
★ 8.5 · 2010 · one of your favourites
A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London.

metas.name: Chernobyl
metas.description:
★ 8.7 · 2019 · one of your favourites
The true story of one of the worst man-made catastrophes in history: the catastrophic nuclear accident at Chernobyl. A tale of the brave men and women who sacrificed to save Europe from unimaginable disaster.

metas.name: Stranger Things
metas.description:
★ 8.5 · 2016 · one of your favourites
When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

metas.name: Better Call Saul
metas.description:
★ 8.7 · 2015 · one of your favourites
Six years before Saul Goodman meets Walter White. We meet him when the man who will become Saul Goodman is known as Jimmy McGill, a small-time lawyer searching for his destiny, and, more immediately, hustling to make…

metas.name: The Boys
metas.description:
★ 8.4 · 2019 · one of your favourites
A group of vigilantes known informally as “The Boys” set out to take down corrupt superheroes with no more than blue-collar grit and a willingness to fight dirty.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description:
★ 8.2 · 2013 · one of your favourites
A single-camera ensemble comedy following the lives of an eclectic group of detectives in a New York precinct, including one slacker who is forced to shape up when he gets a new boss.

metas.name: Seinfeld
metas.description:
★ 8.2 · 1989 · one of your favourites
A stand-up comedian and his three offbeat friends weather the pitfalls and payoffs of life in New York City in the '90s. It's a show about nothing.
